scenario.description: New patient wants earliest available checkup.
scenario.goal: New patient has a confirmed appointment on a weekday during office hours.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hi, I'm a new patient and I'd like to schedule a checkup.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Welcome! I'd be happy to help. Can I get your full name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you Maria. Do you have a preferred day or time, or would you like the earliest available?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have Wednesday at 9:30am with Dr. Patel. Does that work?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're booked for Wednesday at 9:30am. Please arrive 15 minutes early with your ID and insurance card.
